avlm

Methodology: - Lindon, M., Ham, D. W., Tingley, M., and Bojinov, I. (2026). Anytime-Valid Inference in Linear Models with Applications to Regression-Adjusted Causal Inference. Journal of the American Statistical Association. doi:10.1080/01621459.2026.2692052 (preprint: arXiv:2210.08589). - Lindon, M. (2026). Anytime-Valid Inference in Linear Models with Clustered Outcomes: Exact Multivariate Tests and Cluster-Robust Confidence Sequences. arXiv:2610.25613. Cluster-robust inference via av(fit, cluster = ~ id).

Contributors: - Michael Lindon (michael.s.lindon@gmail.com)

Anytime-Valid Linear Regression

Code 

devtools::install_github("michaellindon/avlm")

# Generate Data
set.seed(1)
n = 100
X = scale(replicate(3, rnorm(n)), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
trt = sample(c(0, 1), size = n, replace = TRUE)
y = 1 + 0*X[,1] + 0*X[,2] + 1.4*X[,3] + 2.3*trt + 2*X[,1]*trt + 3*X[,2]*trt + 0*X[,3]*trt + 1*rnorm(n)
df = data.frame(X)
df$trt = trt
df$y = y

# Tune g to minimize the width of the confidence interval at n
alpha = 0.05
number_of_coefficients = ncol(model.matrix(y ~ . + trt * ., data = df))
g_star = optimal_g(n, number_of_coefficients, alpha)

# Summary
classic_fit = lm(y ~ . + trt * ., data = df)
av_fit = av(classic_fit, g = g_star)
summary(av_fit)
confint(av_fit)

Robust Anytime-Valid Linear Regression

Code 

av_fit = av(classic_fit, g=g_star, vcov_estimator = "HC0")
summary(av_fit)
confint(av_fit)

Anytime-Valid Anova

Code 

classic_aov <- aov(Sepal.Length ~ Species, data = iris)
av_aov = av(classic_aov)
summary(av_aov)

Output
